subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should the bounded Discord retry land now as defense in depth while shared permanent recovery remains owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both PRs recover the same session-initialization conflict at different layers; this patch is proven and independently useful, but maintainers must decide whether stacked recovery is intentional.

options.title: Land Discord defense now
options.body: Merge this bounded channel retry after refresh and require the shared-session PR to account for the existing defense-in-depth behavior.

options.title: Wait for shared recovery
options.body: Pause this PR until the shared-session fix lands, then retest whether Discord-specific retry and replay handling remain necessary.

recommendation.title: Land Discord defense now
recommendation.body: Merge this bounded channel retry after refresh and require the shared-session PR to account for the existing defense-in-depth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active adjacent shared-recovery proposal whose behavior must be coordinated with this channel-level defense.
